verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB is a managed ClickHouse warehouse, and warehouse platforms can plausibly ship first-party notebooks, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows that external clients and BI tools (Grafana, Metabase, Superset, Tableau, DBeaver) connect unchanged. Those are third-party tools on the user's side, not a first-party notebook for mixing SQL and Python with inline results and charts.
